ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the Institutional Planned Development No. 462 indications as shown on

Map No. 9-K in the area bounded by

A line 28.23 feet north of and parallel to West School Street; North
Karlov Avenue; West School Street; and the alley next west of and
parallel to North Karlov Avenue

to those of RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

Common Address of Property:

3300 North Karlov Avenue
